summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for environment metadata collection during agent initialization. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (which focus on performance diagnostics and CLS monitoring) or peer candidates (which address Jupyter detection, Research Analyst setup, and Job Description Writer setup). The candidate has clear support from the Debugging Roadmap and addresses a separate concern: capturing OS/Python/SDK/hostname state for debugging. No merge, split, or revision relationship exists with existing or peer skills.
